results.text:
Early on, I watch how fast she decides she knows me. Instant twin flame, big conclusions before she’s asked much, telling me my motives, acting like I’m Lord Krishna. She may genuinely think I’m way better than the other guys she’s found, and maybe I am. There are still parts of me she hasn’t seen yet.

This is part of why I don’t hide the fact that I still love women from my past. They come up because they’re actually in my heart. If that messes with the fairy tale, good. If she can’t handle that I still love them, she isn’t ready for me.

She can also tell me I’m talking about them too much. That’s fair. What bothers me is if everything in her head is supposed to be welcome while I have to edit mine for her.
